attributes.readMe:
# AAC Activity

One sing-along song or nursery rhyme: lyrics with picture-marked key words, a flip book, a melody player, picture games, questions at three levels and printable worksheets.

Part of [Little Voices](../little-voices/ActivityLibrary/little-voices), AAC sing-along songs and nursery rhymes by @ctse.
